# Theme gallery

Twenty ready-made themes to try in Mumcord. Every theme has a dark and a light version, and both pass Mumcord's contrast check, so text stays readable. The Dark / Light / System setting picks which version you see.

## How to import a theme

1. Copy the import code of a theme below (it starts with `mct1.`).
2. Either paste it into any chat: the message shows a theme card, then click **Import**. Or open **Settings → Appearance**, click **Import…**, paste the code and click **Import**.
3. The theme appears under "Your themes" and is applied right away. You can edit it like any of your own themes.

Shared codes only carry colours and a name, nothing else.
